description: Motared frozen behavioural test set (Section 5c). Labels are operator-validated from REAL_WORLD_VALIDATION_REPORT + product ground truth. Do not silently edit labels — bump version and document the change.

protocol.name: MIVIA-IWDD-style temporal event matching
protocol.notes: A predicted confirmation within Δt of the labelled event time is a TP. Predictions farther than T_max from any GT event are FP. Unmatched GT events are FN. Clip-level P/R/F1 also reported (LITTER vs hard-negative).
